XX</cite>, end (ref. to <cite ref="Job 30:23">Job XXX, 23</cite>) <he>אמר … בית מלון לרִבְצִי</he> Adam said, while I am yet in this world, I will build myself a lodging for my rest (in death); <he>וחצב … לרִבְצוֹ</he> and he hewed, and built himself &c.
